newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK & Shanghai in 1-for-12 rights issue.
newsitem.headline: HK & Shanghai in 1-for-12 rights issue.

text.p: Hong Kong and Shanghai Hotels Ltd said on Thursday it sought to raise HK$1.2 billion by means of a one-for-12 rights issue priced at HK$13.10 per rights share.

In addition, a two-year detachable warrant will be attached to each of the new shares issued, with an exercise price calculated by reference to the theoretical ex-right price of HK$13.79 a share, it said in a statement.

The rights issue would be managed by Schroders Asia Ltd and the rights shares to be allocated to the minority shareholders would be underwritten by Schroders Asia Ltd, HSBC Investment Bank Asia Ltd and BZW Asia Ltd, it said.
